name: @aloxberry/daemon
description: LoxBerry plugin daemon for the Aloxberry Alexa Smart Home integration. Holds the outbound WSS connection to the dispatch bridge, subscribes to Miniserver state events over WebSocket, and shells out to a small Perl helper (using LoxBerry::IO) for outbound commands. End-to-end HMAC auth with the AWS Lambda — the bridge is a dumb router.
